messages:
gretchen: Quick QA/design pass on Compliance settings after the last layout change. Three small friction points: (1) region selector keyboard flow drops focus, (2) the KMS/status pill is ambiguous to customers, and (3) audit export timestamps are tripping up auditors. Can we do a short sync?

omar: Repro for (1): Tab to Retention, open it, then Tab to Region. The region menu flashes open then collapses. Happens on Chrome + VoiceOver. Looks like a blur race between trigger and list.

fiona: Fix idea: keep the options container directly after the trigger in DOM order, keep aria-expanded=true until the list gets focus, and only close on Escape or click-out. Also add role=\"listbox\" and manage aria-activedescendant. That should make screen readers announce items.

gretchen: Nice. For (2) support keeps getting \"do you hold my key?\" tickets when the pill says \"Managed key - Redwood.\" We need compact copy that avoids legal misreads. Options I sketched:
- \"Key custody: Redwood\"
- \"Key custody: Customer (BYOK)\"
- Badge + hidden explainer linked via aria-describedby: \"Who can rotate/revoke the master key.\"

omar: I slightly prefer \"Key custody\" over \"Key owner\" because it's less likely to be read as operational access. Also make the pill open a short accessible modal that explains implications (rotation, revocation, access). Keep modal <120 words.

fiona: Visual/a11y nit: the pill hover and focus contrast for 12px microcopy is currently around 3.6:1. Need >=4.5:1. Easiest fix: bump weight to 600 and darken bg a hair. Also ensure focus ring is large and high-contrast.

gretchen: Support asks for a canonical one-line we can paste into replies and a small telemetry hint. Proposal for canned reply: \"Key custody — Redwood-managed / Customer-managed (BYOK). BYOK means you provide the key material; Redwood never has access to your key material.\" For telemetry: add data-key-custody=\"redwood|customer\" on the settings row. Ops: confirm retention window? @support-bot

support-bot: data-key-custody enum is fine. Ensure no key ids or material are included. Recommended retention: 90 days. Do not surface the attr in logs that contain KMS identifiers.

ofiona: For (3) export timestamps: current CSV uses UTC while console shows local time. Security prefers unambiguous exports: always emit ISO-8601 with timezone offset (e.g., 2026-07-01T14:23:00-07:00). In the console show header \"Timestamp (local)\" and tooltip with exact offset plus a toggle to view UTC if needed.

omar: I'll put up a small PR: reorder DOM, add role/listbox, fix blur-close behavior, ensure Tab into the region trigger moves focus to first option when list is open, add aria-describedby to the pill, and adjust pill styles for contrast. I'll attach before/after screenshots and VoiceOver notes.

gretchen: Thanks. Follow-ups: omar include the support canned reply in the PR description, fiona add the modal copy and component README notes for screen readers, support-bot confirm retention with infra. Aim to merge this week. :thumbsup:
